verdict.rationale: Algolia provides an official Crawler for web content, e-commerce/CMS connectors/integrations (Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce, Zendesk), and a no-code data sources/pipeline feature ('Algolia keeps the schedule, the retries, and the transformations') configurable from the dashboard without deploying code, directly addressing founders wanting to avoid writing their own indexing pipeline. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of connector reliability/setup ease specifically, and no evidence of connectors beyond the named platforms (e.g., generic DB/API sources) being as turnkey as claimed.
